title: Run It Yourself: Local Development
description: Commands to start the local development server and test the API endpoints with curl.

steps.description: Empty list: curl localhost:8787/api/questions should return empty array.
Create: POST with JSON body to add a question, expects created question with votes:0.
Upvote: POST to /api/questions/1/upvote, expects same question with votes:1.
Validation: POST with empty text, expects 400 error about length.
